title: The Dark Hand
description: Jackie Chan discovers a golden shield containing a Rooster Talisman in a Bavarian castle. Section 13 recruits him to prevent a criminal syndicate known as the Dark Hand from obtaining all twelve talismans.

title: The Power Within
description: Jackie accidentally swallows the Rooster Talisman. Jade tries to help him harness the power of levitation while the Dark Hand chases him through the city streets.

title: The Mask of El Toro Fuerte
description: Jackie travels to Mexico and finds the Ox Talisman embedded in the mask of a legendary luchador, El Toro Fuerte, who seems to possess superhuman strength.

title: Enter the Viper
description: Jackie encounters Viper, a cunning jewel thief, who steals the Snake Talisman (granting invisibility) from a high-security museum. Jackie must retrieve it before she sells it or is captured by the Dark Hand.

title: Project A, for Astral
description: Jackie finds the Sheep Talisman in a temple, which allows Jade to project her spirit into the astral plane. But when her physical body is left unprotected, the Dark Hand attempts to steal the talisman.

title: Shell Game
description: Jackie finds the Rabbit Talisman (granting super speed) embedded on the shell of a giant tortoise. The Dark Hand pursues him across a remote island, trying to steal the speed of the rabbit.

title: Bullies
description: Valmont steals the Dragon Talisman (granting combustion power) and uses it to demand money from Section 13. Jackie has to confront a super-powered Valmont in a volcanic quarry.

title: Tough Break
description: The Rat Talisman (granting animation to inanimate objects) is placed in a giant action figure of Jade's favorite toy, 'Super Moose'. The toy comes to life and goes on a rampage in San Francisco.

title: The Rock
description: Valmont poisons Jackie with a ancient stone curse that begins turning him into solid rock. Uncle and Jade must locate the Horse Talisman (granting healing/purification) before Jackie is permanently petrified.

title: The Jade Monkey
description: Jackie, Jade, and the Dark Hand discover the Monkey Talisman (shapeshifting) in an underwater ruins. Jackie is accidentally turned into a monkey, and Jade must use the talisman to turn him back.

title: The Dog and Piggy Show
description: Jackie finds the Dog Talisman (immortality) in a Bavarian windmill, while Jade finds the Pig Talisman (heat vision) in a chocolate factory. They must defend them from the Dark Hand.

title: The Tiger and the Pussycat
description: Jackie finds the Tiger Talisman, which splits him into his light and dark halves. The dark Jackie teams up with the Dark Hand, forcing Jade and the light Jackie to stop him.

title: Day of the Dragon
description: Shendu obtains all twelve talismans and turns back into his true giant dragon form. He seeks to destroy San Francisco, and Jackie must use Section 13's arsenal to take him down.

title: Through the Rabbit Hole
description: In the Season 2 premiere, Jade accidentally triggers the Rabbit Talisman and travels back in time to the 1970s. She meets a young Uncle and young Jackie, and must stop Shendu from altering history.

title: The Warrior Incarnate
description: Shendu's spirit enters Valmont's body, forcing the leader of the Dark Hand to cooperate. Uncle sets up magic wards around San Francisco to detect dark magic.

title: Snake Hunt
description: Jackie and Jade join a television nature host in the Amazon jungle, hunting for a snake that swallowed the Snake Talisman. The host makes things difficult by trying to capture it on camera.

title: Mother of All Battles
description: Tohru's mother visits San Francisco, leading to a clash of personalities between her and Uncle. Meanwhile, the Dark Hand plots to steal a valuable ancient artifact.

title: The Stronger Evil
description: The Dark Hand uses Shendu's new dark magic to summon powerful shadow monsters, putting Jackie and Section 13 in extreme danger.

title: The J-Team
description: To protect a Demon Portal in Las Vegas from Shendu/Valmont, Jackie recruits his allies: Viper, Tohru, and El Toro Fuerte, forming the ultimate J-Team.

title: Jade Times Jade
description: Jade uses the clone spell to copy herself so she can avoid doing her chores, but the duplicate Jades cause chaos and get captured by the Shadowkhan.

title: The Curse of El Chupacabra
description: Jackie travels to Mexico to help his friend El Toro Fuerte, who is haunted by the legendary monster El Chupacabra.

title: Rumble in the Big House
description: Jackie goes undercover inside a high-security prison to find the location of a hidden treasure before the Dark Hand can get it.

title: Lost City of the Muntabs
description: Jackie and Jade search for a missing archaeologist in a legendary lost city, only to discover the inhabitants are using a magical spring to stay young.

title: And He Does His Own Stunts
description: Jackie is hired as a stunt coordinator for a movie in Hollywood, but the film set is attacked by dark forces searching for a talisman.

title: Showdown in the Old West
description: Uncle tells Jade the story of their ancestor, a sheriff in the Old West, who had to stop a dark wizard and his gang.

title: Queen of the Shadowkhan
description: Jade gets a tattoo of Shendu's face on her ankle, which slowly turns her evil and makes her the new Queen of the Shadowkhan.

title: Origami
description: A thief who can fold himself into any paper shape steals a precious artwork. Jackie must find a way to stop him.

title: Shanghai Moon
description: The Dark Hand attempts to release a Demon Sorcerer from a portal located on a space shuttle orbiting the Earth. Jackie and Jade must travel to space to stop them.

title: The Lotus Temple
description: Jackie and Jade discover a mysterious temple that only appears during the full moon, where they meet a girl cursed to be the temple's guardian.

title: Armor of the Gods
description: Jackie must locate the legendary Armor of the Eight Immortals to defeat a newly released demon. Meanwhile, Jade struggles with sleepwalking.

title: Agent Tag
description: Jackie teams up with a clumsy Section 13 agent named Tag to stop a dark wizard from stealing magical artifacts.

title: Tale of the Demon Tail
description: Shendu's spirit attempts to locate his lost tail to regain his magical powers, while Jackie and Jade try to intercept him.

title: The Return of the Pussycat
description: The Tiger Talisman's split personality magic is accidentally triggered again, separating Jackie into light and dark halves right when a new threat emerges.

title: Scouts Honor
description: Jackie and Jade go on a scout camping trip in the mountains, but their trip is disrupted by a creature hunting for a talisman.

title: Danger in the Deep Freeze
description: Jackie travels to the Arctic to retrieve a frozen prehistoric creature, but the creature wakes up and is filled with dark magic.

title: Into the Mouth of Evil
description: Jackie goes undercover to infiltrate a mysterious dark cult searching for an ancient portal.

title: The King and Jade
description: Jade becomes friends with a young king who is visiting San Francisco, but she must protect him from assassins hired by his rebellious uncle.

title: The New Atlantis
description: The Water Demon tries to sink San Francisco to create a new underwater empire. Jackie and Section 13 must stop the city from flooding.

title: The Eighth Door
description: The J-Team must close the final demon portal before Shendu and the Demon Sorcerers can release their dark empire upon the Earth.

title: Demon World (Part 1)
description: In the Season 2 climax, Shendu successfully alters the Book of Ages, rewriting history so that the Demon Sorcerers rule the Earth.

title: Demon World (Part 2)
description: Jackie and Jade must lead the resistance against the Demon Sorcerers and find a way to access the Book of Ages to restore history.

title: Enter the Cat
description: Jackie is scratched by a magical cat statue, which slowly turns him into a wild feline creature.

title: Pleasure Cruise
description: Jackie is hired to guard a valuable artifact on a luxury cruise ship, but the ship is hijacked by the Dark Hand.

title: Tough Luck
description: The Dark Hand steals a cursed gemstone that brings extreme bad luck to anyone who holds it, leading to a series of chaotic accidents.

title: The Chosen One
description: A group of monks declares Tohru to be the reincarnated Chosen One destined to save the temple from a dark wizard.

title: Glove Story
description: Tohru buys a pair of antique gloves that turn out to be magical, forcing him to steal precious gems against his will.

title: The Chan Who Knew Too Much
description: Jackie is accidentally exposed to a magical relic that gives him super-intelligence, but his brain starts overloading.

title: Chi of the Vampire
description: Jackie and Uncle encounter a soul-stealing vampire in a castle in Europe. Jade must use her magic to save Jackie's chi.

title: The Good, the Bad, the Blind, the Deaf and the Mute
description: Three dark wizards use a curse to steal Jackie, Tohru, and Jade's senses (sight, hearing, and voice). They must work together to defeat them.

title: Shrink Rap
description: A magic spell accidentally shrinks Jackie and Jade to the size of insects. They must navigate a dangerous house to break the spell.

title: I'll Be a Monkey's Puppet
description: Jackie gets trapped inside a monkey puppet statue while the puppet takes control of his body.

title: The Amazing T-Girl
description: In the Season 2 finale, Jade obtains the powers of the Tiger Talisman, splitting into two Jades who must stop Shendu's final plan.

title: Re-Enter the J Team
description: The Dark Hand uses a new method to track down the talismans. Jackie must call back the J-Team to stop them.

title: The Powers Unleashed
description: The talismans are destroyed, but their magic is scattered into noble animals. Jackie must find these animals before Shendu does.

title: Viva Las Jackies
description: Jackie and Jade hunt for the noble animal representing the Tiger Talisman in Las Vegas.

title: Aztec Rat Race
description: Jackie travels to Mexico to find the noble Rat representing the Rat Talisman.

title: Monkey a Go-Go
description: A pet monkey is found to possess the shapeshifting powers of the Monkey Talisman.

title: When Pigs Fly
description: A farm pig and a rooster receive talisman powers, causing chaos on a farm.

title: Rabbit Run
description: Jackie chases a fast jackrabbit in the desert that has absorbed the Rabbit Talisman's speed.

title: Sheep In, Sheep Out
description: The noble Sheep is found, allowing characters to project their astral forms.

title: The Invisible Mom
description: Jade's mother accidentally becomes invisible after contact with the noble Snake.

title: A Jolly J-Team Xmas
description: The J-Team works together to save Santa Claus and Christmas from a dark sorcerer.

title: Little Valmont, Big Jade
description: A magic potion shrinks Valmont to a child, while Jade is magnified to a giant size.

title: The Ox-Head Incident
description: Jackie tracks the noble Ox representing the Ox Talisman's superhuman strength.

title: Animal Crackers
description: Several noble animals are captured by the Dark Hand, leading to a massive rescue mission by Jackie.

title: Tohru Who
description: Tohru suffers from amnesia after a magical explosion and forgets his time with Section 13.

title: Re-Enter the Dragon
description: The noble Dragon is found, and Shendu attempts to merge with it to regain his physical form.

title: A Night at the Opera
description: Jackie and Uncle attend a Chinese opera performance, which is disrupted by an ancient rival of Uncle.

title: Attack of the J-Clones
description: The Dark Hand creates evil clones of the J-Team to infiltrate Section 13.

title: The Masks of the Shadowkhan
description: Jackie learns about the nine Oni Masks which can summon different tribes of Shadowkhan. Daolon Wong's escape threatens to unleash them.

title: Samurai Ratso
description: Ratso accidentally wears an Oni Mask, transforming into a powerful samurai demon leader.

title: The Amazing T-Troop
description: Jade forms a team of superheroes including El Toro Fuerte and Viper to stop a demon summoned by a new mask.

title: Black Magic
description: Valmont wears a mask that makes him the new general of the Shadowkhan, and tries to rob a museum.

title: The Demon Behind
description: Tohru gets stuck wearing a mask and struggles to fight the evil urge to command the Shadowkhan.

title: Fright Fight Night
description: Jackie travels to a wrestling tournament where a wrestler is using an Oni mask to gain unfair power.

title: The Shadow Eaters
description: A tiny dog eats a mask and gains the ability to summon Shadowkhan that eat people's shadows.

title: Half a Mask of Kung-Fu
description: An Oni mask is split in half. One half is attached to Valmont and the other to Jackie, causing their movements to be mirrored.

title: The Good Guys
description: The Enforcers (Chow, Ratso, Finn) decide to turn good and help Section 13, but finding trust is difficult.

title: J2 Rise of the Dragons
description: A future version of Jade (J2) travels back in time to help the J-Team stop Drago (Shendu's son) from releasing dragons.

title: The J-Tots
description: A magical spell turns the J-Team into toddlers, leaving Jade to lead them against a dark wizard.

title: Deja Vu
description: Jackie gets trapped in a time loop, repeating a dangerous mission over and over again.

title: Ninja Twilight
description: In the Season 4 finale, the J-Team must defeat the Oni Generals in the Shadowlands to stop the world from being engulfed in darkness.

title: Relics of Demons Past
description: Shendu's son, Drago, escapes from Section 13 and begins searching for the seven dark relics containing the powers of the Demon Sorcerers. Jackie and Jade must stop him.

title: It's All in the Game
description: Drago locates the relic containing the Wind Demon's power, which is hidden inside an antique fan. A game show host gets caught in the crossfire.

title: Black and White and Chi All Over
description: Drago attempts to absorb the Earth Demon's power from a flower. Uncle and Jackie must use light magic to counter him.

title: Dragon Scouts
description: Jade joins a scout troop and suspects three new boys are secretly Drago's fire demon helpers.

title: The Demon Beneath My Wings
description: Drago finds the Sky Demon's relic, which is a pair of antique wings. Jade gets accidentally fused with the wings.

title: Mirror, Mirror
description: Drago uses a magic mirror to trap the J-Team's spirits, replacing them with evil shadow copies.

title: Antler Action
description: Drago hunts for the relic containing the Mountain Demon's power, hidden inside a set of ancient antlers.

title: Clash of the Titanics
description: The Water Demon's power is hidden inside an antique compass. Jackie and Drago battle on a sinking cargo ship to retrieve it.

title: Stealing Thunder
description: Drago gains the Thunder Demon's power from an ancient drum and attacks Section 13 with massive lightning storms.

title: Weight and See
description: Jackie obtains the power of the Mountain Demon, making him grow extremely heavy and hard to move.

title: J2 Revisited
description: Future Jade (J2) returns once again to help the present J-Team prevent Drago from conquering the future.

title: The Powers That Be (1)
description: Drago successfully captures all seven demon powers. He plans to unleash the Demon World, leaving Uncle and Section 13 in a desperate race against time.

title: The Powers That Be (2)
description: In the series finale, Uncle summons Shendu to fight Drago. The father and son dragons battle, and the J-Team uses all their magic to seal them both away forever.
